items.title_orig: True Or False: Pearl Jam’s Vs. (1993) is better Ten (1991) and Pearl Jam’s best album?
items.article_text:
I’d say true because it’s slightly a more diverse and political album with great songs like the album opener, Go, Animal, Glorified G, Dissident, W.M.A, Rearviewmirror, Rats, Elderly Woman, Leash and the incredible album closer, Indifference. The only song I hate on it is Daughter just because of how overplayed it was back in the day.
 Also, it was the first PJ album with Dave A. as the drummer and this album was the peak of his drumming output.
